title: Ярусы 16 и 8 мс на Galaxy A12, 7–10 октября: каждая строка реестра CORE_REALTIME от 4m до 4ad
source: ntsd-2.4 at 5f5a8ee4: docs/research/CORE_REALTIME.md (Ledger) and the evidence file named in each row (docs/evidence/rt-*.json); commit times from git (+0200)
caveat: One phone (Galaxy A12, Helio P35: CPUs 0-3 at 2.3 GHz, 4-7 at 1.8 GHz), debuggable build (local.ntsd.port), shipping flags from 4aa on (no dynamic exclusivity checks); scripted match (vs: computer vs computer, bodies 300->1800; Demo: eight computer fighters) with music, sounds and network off, no frame capture, the harness's virtual clock (8 ms per message-loop iteration). Compute per tick per thread from schedstat between bodies 600 and 1500 (tools/crossplatform/android_speed.py); not wall time. after = mean of the step's runs; base = mean of the previous build's runs interleaved in the same session (the phone drifts between sessions, so compare after with base, not with the previous step's after). The phone resolves about ±0.25 ms per run (CORE_REALTIME.md). From R2 (10 Oct) the Android present runs on its own presenter thread and is not in 'render'; from R3 freeing runs on a release thread and is not in 'main'. verdict: kept = measurably faster; less = committed as strictly less work within noise; reverted/parked = measured and not committed; follow/test/telemetry/procedure/build/decision as named. review: ok/nits = independent read-only review approved (with nits); caught = the review or a gate found a defect that was fixed before the commit; skipped = recorded as not required; none = no review field.
